SQA Portfolio: live test reports

Reports from the latest CI run on the main branch. The performance report is the full 12-minute run committed to the repository; the others are regenerated on every push.

UI automation

Playwright report (Chromium): every test, steps, timings, screenshots of failures.

API tests

Newman report: requests, assertions, response times. Secrets are redacted.

API validation matrix

Fourteen invalid and unusual request bodies sent through one request, showing which ones the API mishandles.

The same create, read and delete flow over six data rows, including Unicode names.

Performance

k6 smoke, load, stress, spike and soak results with the breaking point and recovery.
